report_topic: Public Health Infrastructure and Management of Health Services in Telangana State
observations_summary: The audit found significant human resource shortages (45% overall vacancies), inadequate infrastructure (e.g., 69% shortage in CHCs, 7,008 bed shortage), and non-functional facilities. Financial management showed underutilization of funds (36-63% for NHM) and low health sector spending (2.53-3.47% of state budget). Issues with drug procurement, quality control, and unutilized equipment were also noted.
